analysis_type: post-hoc descriptive diagnosis, not a new confirmatory test
coverage: all 90 accepted models; all 13 conditions; all 252 independent final images
selection: One A/B example per category and role; first maximize recurrence across three seeds; then prefer stress conditions; FP budget order all,25,10,5; FN budget order 5,10,25,all; then frozen condition order, image path, seed ascending. No substitute if empty.
heatmaps: Saved bilinear maps divided by each model own image threshold; common color scale within each panel; not probabilities or pixel segmentation decisions. Image scores use raw patch maxima and may differ from interpolated map maxima.
